description: A migrator resource: a service.json with appType migrator is registered with tdk resource, and tdk status lists it as a migrator (openspec task 3.6, #1290). No stack is started. Routed health does not apply: a migrator serves no HTTP route. The Postgres, migrator, API order is blocked on #531 (docs/data.md does not guarantee that order), so it is not tested here.
